The '''KX756 marksman barrel''' was a model of [[marksman barrel]] produced by [[Merr-Sonn Munitions, Inc./Legends|Merr-Sonn Munitions, Inc.]] and available in the period following the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] between the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] and the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]]. The barrel was suitable only for [[Blaster rifle/Legends|blaster rifles]], measuring two [[Meter/Legends|meters]] in length and constructed of lightweight material. Upgraded [[static pulse adapter]]s and a denser galven circuitry pattern mean that the barrel gives increased accuracy and range to weapons it is incorporated into. The downside to the barrel was that its length made it unwieldy and impossible to conceal. The barrel was popular along [[Assassin/Legends|assassins]] and [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunters]] as well as fringers who had need of long range, the audience it was intended for.<ref name="EOTEC" />

==Behind the scenes==
KX756 marksman barrels were first mentioned in the [[Star Wars: Edge of the Empire Core Rulebook|''Star Wars: Edge of the Empire'' Core Rulebook]] released by [[Fantasy Flight Games]] in [[2014]].
